history.reasoning_content: The bug: after spreading on select, the final `effect` calls `select_option(select, prev.value)` where prev.value is undefined, setting selectedIndex = -1, clearing the selected option. Without spread, that effect never runs. Fix: only call select_option if 'value' in prev. Also init_select triggers observer. Let me record hypotheses.
